messages:
deploy-bot: starting deploy -> canary rollout for inference-api v2.1.3-rc to prod (5% traffic). change window 30m. monitors: svc.latency_p95, svc.error_rate, svc.cpu. runbook: https://redwood/internal/runbooks/deploys. tagging logs with deploy=canary :rocket:

maya: noted. I'll keep an eye on SLO dashboard and traces. who has the canary host list?

ryan: got it, @maya — canary hosts are infra-canary-{3,4,7}. pulling dashboard now.

elena: seeing a small blip in 5xx on canary already, ~0.6% over last 2m. sending query:
```
# Prometheus
sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="inference-api",status=~"5..",deploy="canary"}[2m]))
/ sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="inference-api",deploy="canary"}[2m]))
```

sre-ops-bot: ALERT at 1750123499: monitor=canary-inference-5xx threshold=0.5% window=2m — current=0.73% :warning:

ryan: yeah that's the one. p95 latency also up to ~420ms from baseline 180ms. not huge but correlated with errors.

vikram: quick triage — is it model-serving path or proxy layer? any new kernel changes in this build?

elena: build diff shows only a small batching tweak and a dependency bump in tok-fast. I'll attach the release note snippet.

maya: recommend we hold further traffic until 10m of stable metrics. rollback threshold I'd set: error_rate > 0.5% for 3 consecutive 2m windows OR p95 > 600ms for 2 windows.

tara: +1 on thresholds. also let's pin the remaining 95% to stable v2.1.2 (already configured) and keep canary at 5%.

ryan: doing a quick trace sample: trace ids: rtr-8f3, rtr-8f7. looks like tail latency on tokenizer call spikes. sending logs: `grep tokenizer /var/log/canary/*.log | tail -n 50`

sre-ops-bot: metric spike correlation: cpu slightly higher on canary node infra-canary-4, but not OOM.

elena: trying a canary restart on infra-canary-4 to see if that clears the tokenizer tail.

deploy-bot: paused further canary promotions at 5% as requested by humans.

maya: after restart, errors dipped to 0.22% over last 2m. p95 back to ~200ms.

vikram: hunch: dependency bump introduced a race under certain tokenization loads. leaving canary up but not promoting. we should run a targeted unit test on tokenizer with high concurrency.

ryan: agree. I'll kick off the test job and re-run the canary in staging with same bump. if it reproduces we'll rollback the change and cut a new patch.

sre-ops-bot: ALERT RESOLVE at 1750123562: monitor=canary-inference-5xx — resolved after node restart.

maya: given the transient, i propose we abort this canary and mark v2.1.3-rc as blocked for now. action: rollback canary and add a note to release PR.

deploy-bot: executing rollback for canary routing at 1750123573. traffic reverted to v2.1.2 for all non-canary routes.

ryan: confirmed rollback done. no further 5xx on prod in next 5m.

tara: will update the release notes: "canary aborted due to tokenizer dependency causing transient 5xx; investigation ongoing; v2.1.3-rc blocked". also filing follow-up ticket RT-1259 to track reproducer.

maya: thanks everyone. thumbs if you want the postmortem template filled now or after reproducer. :thumbsup:

vikram: +1 to fill after a reproducer.

elena: adding log excerpts and the prom query to the ticket.

deploy-bot: deployment event closed at 1750123578. summary: canary aborted, traffic reverted, engineers investigating.
